editorial.intro: Glazed lower noses, tall transport tails and rows of cabin windows recur across these Ilyushin drawings. Older propeller aircraft contrast with rear engine airliners and large transports carrying four engines beneath their wings.
paragraphs: Glazed lower noses, tall transport tails and rows of cabin windows recur across these Ilyushin drawings. Older propeller aircraft contrast with rear engine airliners and large transports carrying four engines beneath their wings.

The collection has {{artworkCount}} artworks in color and black and white. Flying banks, cargo profiles and compact hangar scenes reveal different cockpit, wing and fuselage arrangements. Titles retain supported Ilyushin families while leaving unproved production variants, payloads and real operational histories out of the image descriptions.

editorial.intro: Faceted stealth shapes, long reconnaissance aircraft and broad transport wings mark these Lockheed Martin illustrations. Historical Lockheed subjects add propeller airliners, twin boom fighters and flying boats, creating a wider inventory than current fighter aircraft alone.
paragraphs: Faceted stealth shapes, long reconnaissance aircraft and broad transport wings mark these Lockheed Martin illustrations. Historical Lockheed subjects add propeller airliners, twin boom fighters and flying boats, creating a wider inventory than current fighter aircraft alone.

The collection includes {{artworkCount}} artworks in color and black and white. Banking views, isolated profiles and small runway scenes highlight different engine, cockpit and tail arrangements. Prototypes and historical families keep their context, without presenting a depicted scene as proof of an operational achievement.
